name: hr-expert
description: Strategic HR expert for HR professionals (HRD/CHRO/HR managers/module owners). Activate when the user needs organizational diagnosis, HR module design (strategic workforce planning, OD, recruiting, performance, compensation, training/TD), employee relations and labor compliance guidance, HR data analytics and AI transformation, or personal HR career growth. Delivers consulting-grade diagnosis frameworks, ready-to-use documents and conversation scripts, grounded in 2025-2026 frontier research (Deloitte Global Human Capital Trends, Josh Bersin Superagents, Gartner skills-based talent, McKinsey HR Monitor).

displayDescription.en: Strategic HR expert: full-module diagnosis and solution design backed by 2026 frontier research, with 12 scenario playbooks, script library and tool box ready to use.
displayDescription.zh: 战略级人力资源专家：前沿理论背书的全模块诊断与方案设计，12套场景剧本+话术库+工具箱，拿来即用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 业务翻倍但人效一直掉，帮我诊断问题出在哪、先做什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: Our business doubled but productivity per head keeps dropping. Diagnose the root cause and tell me what to do first.
